dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: Short and squat wooden houses, sparsely scattered... Sometimes, a village like this can be easier to guard than a city.

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: When hunting demons, I just want bystanders out of the area, so I can focus on fighting.

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: ...So this is what human construction looks like up close.
